tagline: One of the largest owners and operators of open-air shopping centers in the U.S.
hero_kpi_rationale: The Rent Spread is the primary indicator of leasing momentum in the commercial real estate sector, reflecting the company's ability to increase rents upon each renewal. It is a key driver of organic cash flow growth.

kpis.name: Écart de loyer
kpis.explanation: Percentage difference between the new signed rent and the previous rent for comparable leases.
kpis.description: The Rent Spread stands at 16.4% in 2025, slightly down from 16.5% in 2024, indicating moderate pressure on new rental rates.
kpis.signal: Stable leasing growth despite macroeconomic slowdown.

kpis.name: Taux d'occupation facturé
kpis.explanation: Percentage of leasable space for which rent is being billed.
kpis.description: The billed occupancy rate reached 91.6% at the end of 2025, up 0.2 point from 2024.

kpis.name: Taux d'occupation loué
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total space that is leased, including spaces under construction.
kpis.description: The leased occupancy rate was 95.1% at the end of 2025, compared to 95.2% at the end of 2024.
kpis.signal: High occupancy rate but slight decline.

kpis.name: Surface totale locative
kpis.explanation: Total square footage in millions available for leasing across the portfolio.
kpis.description: The portfolio includes 348 shopping centers totaling approximately 63 million square feet at the end of 2025.
kpis.signal: Stable portfolio of 63 million square feet.

kpis.name: Acquisitions annuelles
kpis.explanation: Total value of shopping centers and land acquired during the year.
kpis.description: The company acquired $420.6 million in assets in 2025, compared to $293.8 million in 2024.

kpis.name: Cessions annuelles
kpis.explanation: Net proceeds from the disposal of real estate assets.
kpis.description: Dispositions generated $289.2 million in 2025, compared to $208.2 million in 2024.
